facts.text: The window booth at Roadside Cafe.
facts.why: The still above the caption is the twins in matching suits against the sky (the poster art), not a cafe booth. No source shows the twins at this cafe at all: Arroyo Seco is a filming location for the road trip and no page says what happens there.
facts.applied_text: Julius and Marnie share a motel room.
facts.applied_note: The poster-art stills are now hidden (data/still-block.json), so the band above the caption is the motel-room still of Marnie and Julius; the caption describes that still. Venue changed from Roadside Cafe to the Sun God Lodge, Taos.

facts.text: Overheard at the counter: the fuel injector in the Cadillac boot.
facts.why: Vincent finds the prototype fuel injector in the boot of the Cadillac he steals in Los Angeles. Nobody talks about it at a cafe counter; the stock 'Overheard at the counter' frame turns a prop into dialogue in the wrong place.
facts.fix: In the stolen Cadillac's boot: one fuel injector.
facts.applied_text: In the stolen Cadillac's boot: one fuel injector.

vibe.verdict: The Sun God Lodge, the real tagline and fresh stills fix the worst of it and the quotes are well used, but the stock diner furniture (pie case, open all night) and missing Houston plot keep it middling.
missing: Julius bailing Vincent out of jail in LA
Whispering Pines, the art colony where they find their mother
Webster and the $5 million showdown in Houston
ideas: Replace the invented Roadside Cafe with a place the film actually shows on the road trip or in LA, keeping the diner layout
Swap the second hero still for a different TMDB still so the poster does not print twice
Swap the front's 'Only the waitress can tell them apart.' for the real tagline nod 'Only their mother can tell them apart.'
Swap 'Bottomless shoestring fries' for something from Julius's island upbringing
changed: Venue: Sun God Lodge, Paseo del Pueblo Sur, Taos, the motel the twins, Linda and Marnie stay at (was the Roadside Cafe filming location)
Tagline now the real one: 'Only their mother can tell them apart.'
Poster art no longer printed twice; back still is the motel room (Marnie and Julius), last still the twins' hug
Front desk ticket: 'Two rooms, four guests' / 'Vincent's in Linda's room'; stock lines remapped (Left at the front desk, Vacancy, Check out by ten)
House fries swapped for 'Island fruit salad: Julius grew up on an island. Vincent didn't.'
Footer: 'In the stolen Cadillac's boot: one fuel injector.'
changed2: Stock 'Ask about pie' card now reads 'Next stop, Houston'
